profile.source_text: I work on cavity QED and quantum interconnects, especially optical cavities that connect remote quantum nodes and enable quantum state transfer.
negative_topics: integrated photonics without cavity QED or quantum networking
positive_examples: Entanglement generation between remote emitters through an optical cavity
negative_examples: A general-purpose integrated photonic wavelength router

papers.title: Cavity-Mediated Entanglement Between Remote Quantum Network Nodes
papers.abstract: We demonstrate a protocol for distributing entanglement between remote quantum emitters using an optical cavity interface and coherent state transfer.

papers.title: Fiber-Based Entanglement Distribution for a Metropolitan Quantum Network
papers.abstract: Remote quantum nodes exchange entanglement over deployed fiber without resonant optical cavities.

papers.title: Nonlinear Dynamics in a Multimode Optical Cavity
papers.abstract: We study classical nonlinear mode competition and frequency conversion in a driven optical cavity.

papers.title: Compact Integrated Photonic Router for Wavelength-Division Multiplexing
papers.abstract: A silicon photonics circuit implements low-loss routing for classical optical communication systems.
